Subject: Redwood <> FinTechCorp - Post-demo follow-up (security & incident response)

Alex — thanks again for the demo today, really appreciate the time. Quick recap and asks so we can keep the procurement loop moving: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm current SOC 2 status (Type II with coverage dates)? If you have the report available, please share the auditor name and date.
- Regulatory scope: are there any HIPAA or specific GDPR data locality constraints we should be aware of for the integration?
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned a short security questionnaire — if you can send it over we’ll start populating. We can also provide our standard evidence pack.
- Incident response / breach notification: we need to confirm your expected notification timeline and any contractual obligations you require (e.g., 72 hours).
- BCP/DR evidence: for our internal review, please share RTO/RPO targets and any tabletop/DR test results if available.

Next steps from our side: Ben will scope an AMS/implementation timeline once we lock the SLA requirements; Marissa (CS) will follow on onboarding and data-handling questions.

If easier, loop in your security contact and I’ll coordinate a mini Q&A session — we can carve out 30 minutes early next week.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0142

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechcorp.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood <> FinTechCorp - Post-demo follow-up (security & incident response)

Laura,

Great speaking with you and the team — appreciate the thorough recap. Answers inline below and attaching our vendor questionnaire.

- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; coverage period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Auditor: ClearCheck Audit LLP. Im attaching the executive summary, full report available under NDA — we can provide a redacted copy if needed.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We process customer data under GDPR; for regulated data we support EU region controls. FinTechCorp is not a HIPAA-covered entity but we can sign contractual terms if PHI arises.
- Vendor questionnaire: attached (Vendor-Questionnaire-FinTechCorp.xlsx). If Redwood needs a different template, send it over and well prioritize.
- Incident response / breach notification: Our policy is to notify verified customers within 72 hours of confirming a reportable breach. We can discuss contractual notification windows but 72 hours is our baseline.
- BCP/DR: RTO target for critical systems is 4 hours, RPO is 1 hour. We perform DR tabletop exercises quarterly; last tabletop was Feb 2026. Ive attached the summary slides.

Let me know if you want a short call with our security lead (ccd security@fintechcorp.com).

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Senior PM, Integrations | FinTechCorp
alex.morgan@fintechcorp.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood <> FinTechCorp - Post-demo follow-up (security & incident response)

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick responses and the questionnaire. Looping in Rishi (security) and Marissa (CS) to coordinate the evidence exchange. A couple of clarifying asks for our security review: 

1) For SOC 2: can you confirm whether the report covers SaaS change management and incident response controls (CC6/CC7 equivalents)? If the full report is under NDA we can share our standard NDA and an evidence intake form.
2) For breach notification: is the 72-hour timeline measured from detection, confirmation, or regulatory determination? Our legal team prefers confirmation-of-impact as the start point, but we have customers that require from detection.
3) BCP/DR evidence: would you be able to provide the most recent tabletop test results (slides or test report) and the DR runbook excerpt (RTO/RPO verification steps)? We’re fine receiving redacted versions over secure Drive.

Rishi/Marissa — can you review the attached questionnaire and mark any items you want prioritized? Ben, please add these requirements into the commercial proposal (SLA exceptions, evidence delivery timelines).

If helpful Ill propose 30 minutes Wed (Mar 17) at 15:00 PT to run through outstanding items with your security team.

Best,
Laura

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechcorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood <> FinTechCorp - Post-demo follow-up (security & incident response)

Alex — thanks for the attachments and the clear baseline. Quick notes from security: 

- SOC 2 scope: please confirm that the report tests incident response and change management controls. If the report does not map to our control IDs, a short mapping table (report section -> Redwood control) will suffice.
- Notification window: Redwoods standard contract requires notification within 72 hours of confirmed customer-impacting breach. If FinTechCorp measures from detection, please confirm you can commit to 72 hours from either detection OR confirmation (we can accept either with a note during legal review).
- Evidence transfer: For the tabletop/test and runbook excerpts, a redacted PDF uploaded to the shared Drive link is fine. Wed like to see (a) date of test, (b) participants list, (c) post-mortem action items, and (d) RTO/RPO measured outcomes.

We can accept the SOC 2 executive summary initially; full report under NDA is OK. On our side Ive attached a small evidence checklist to accelerate intake. If we can get the SOC 2 exec summary + completed vendor questionnaire by EOD Thu (Mar 19), that keeps our legal/compliance review on track for next-week contracting.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
